retrievalProfile.description: A portrait-centered composition featuring a subject breaking the fourth wall of an ornate gold frame against a gritty, textured background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central male figure in streetwear is positioned within a heavy, ornate gold picture frame. The frame sits atop a dark, cracked concrete wall. Bright cyan lens flares slice diagonally across the composition, while the internal background of the frame features warm, sepia-toned historical or classical imagery. High-contrast typography is layered both behind and in front of the subject to create depth.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject breaking the frame boundary to create 3D depth
Warm gold and sepia tones contrasted by cool cyan light streaks
Ornate classical framing against industrial concrete textures
Aggressive, large-scale typography overlapping the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical orientation; subject occupies 70% of the frame height, breaking the top and bottom edges.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The ornate gold frame acts as the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Diagonal flow from top-right to bottom-left following the light streaks and the placement of text blocks.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is dense with texture, light effects, and layered typography.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black and dark grey (shadows and background)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright highlights on the subject and the dark, textured background.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme vertical stretching on primary titles
Heavy black outlines to separate text from busy backgrounds
characterSpecificRedesigns: Enlarged 'T' and 'A' to bookend the primary name
Blackletter 'Loyal' with thick white strokes and heavy black drop shadows
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive blackletter paired with high-contrast, sharp-serif display fonts and small sans-serif metadata.

preserve: The contrast between the white text and black outlines
The diagonal orientation of the light streaks

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the aggressive urban-baroque aesthetic of the 'Loyal' text.
Provides the sharp, elegant serif look for the secondary display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man in streetwear inside an ornate gold frame. The frame should be set against a dark, cracked concrete wall. Add sepia-toned classical imagery inside the frame behind the man. Include bright cyan diagonal light streaks.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, high-contrast blackletter and serif typography. Use thick black outlines for the white text and place it so it overlaps the subject and the frame to create a 3D effect.

verificationChecks: Does the subject break the frame boundary?
Are the cyan light streaks diagonal and vibrant?
Is the typography outlined for legibility against the texture?
Is the background texture sufficiently gritty?

mustRedesign: Unique tattoo patterns on the subject

mustAchieve: Gilded metallic texture on the frame
Sharp, legible typography despite busy background

postGenerationChecks: Check for 3D depth between subject, frame, and text
Verify the color contrast between cyan and gold
Ensure the concrete texture does not muddy the subject
Confirm the typography feels integrated into the scene
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Ornate Gold Frame + Gritty Concrete + Cyan Light Streaks + High-Contrast Blackletter Typography
